source: Lauritzen & Spiegelhalter (1988), 'Local computations with probabilities on graphical structures', JRSS-B 50(2): 157-224; bnlearn 'asia'

variables.name: VisitAsia
variables.definition: Whether the patient recently visited Asia.

variables.name: Smoking
variables.definition: Whether the patient is a smoker.

variables.name: LungCancer
variables.definition: Whether the patient has lung cancer.

variables.name: TubOrCancer
variables.definition: Whether the patient has either tuberculosis or lung cancer (i.e. true if at least one of the two is present).

variables.name: XRay
variables.definition: Whether the patient's chest X-ray shows an abnormal result.

variables.name: Dyspnoea
variables.definition: Whether the patient has shortness of breath.
